answer_1.quote: We provide a preliminary study learning Dyck-(k,m) with LSTM LMs from finite samples, finding ... that learned LSTM LMs extrapolate well given the hidden sizes predicted by our theory.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate perplexity on the development set after every epoch... We evaluate the behavior of the LSTM LMs in hierarchical memory management, that is, in remembering what type of bracket i can come next. ... we report mean j p_j, to evaluate the model's bracket-closing memory.
